name: Luxevara
summary: Swiss-modern boutique hotel group site with tight Inter Display headlines, a giant lowercase wordmark across a film-grain city photo, mist-blue and ink blocks and one electric lime accent.

fonts.pairing: single grotesk family: 500 weight with very tight negative tracking for display, 400 for body, uppercase tracked labels

signature: lime em-rule before the second line of every headline, set as part of the type
giant lowercase wordmark spanning the full hero width over a grainy photo
sticky stacked hotel cards with big outline index numbers 01 to 03
numbered experience table rows with category tags on the right edge
imagery: analogue film-look Paris streets, rooftops and cafes, grainy and cool, interiors and food in warm light
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 32px side padding, 128px section padding, 2-column split headers, 4-column service cards, pill buttons at 100px radius
